patterns.note: A full-bleed dark background is used consistently, with content sections often featuring slightly lighter dark backgrounds or subtle gradients to differentiate them.
Headings are large, bold, and sans-serif, creating a strong visual hierarchy and dramatic impact, complemented by highly legible body text.
A sophisticated dark mode palette dominates, featuring stark white text against deep blacks and dark grays, accented by warm, inviting orange and peach tones for CTAs and highlights.
The hero content (large text and 3D globe) scrolls out of view, while the navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport.
Dramatic, full-screen text statements ('SPENT', 'SENT', 'RECEIVED', 'CONVERTED') are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls down the page, creating a narrative progression.
Feature sections frequently utilize a grid of cards, often with subtle background imagery or gradients that enhance the dark aesthetic.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky navigation bar that remains visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down, providing persistent access to key links.

Scroll-triggered animations are used to reveal full-screen text statements ('SPENT', 'SENT', 'RECEIVED', 'CONVERTED') sequentially, likely fading them in or sliding them up as they enter the viewport, creating a dramatic narrative flow.
The hero section features a large, dark background with a prominent 3D globe graphic, potentially a video or interactive element, which scrolls out of view to reveal subsequent content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) for dramatic impact, paired with clean, well-spaced body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (buttons, cards, and input fields have slightly rounded corners)
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within card grids, creating a sense of spaciousness

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dark, almost cinematic aesthetic combined with dramatic, full-screen scroll-triggered text reveals creates a powerful and engaging narrative experience. The subtle glowing elements and sophisticated typography elevate it beyond a typical fintech site.
